propositions: The close precheck scans historical commit messages and prints ambiguity resolver errors for unrelated short-ID references even though it only needs to validate against accepted target IDs.
The shared resolver writes diagnostics to stderr for every extracted reference without suppression, polluting output when scanning unrelated commits.
A later valid full-ID reference is correctly detected, but the unrelated ambiguity errors remain visible as noise.
The close precheck should resolve references silently while preserving normal resolver diagnostics for user-facing commands.
